仍然高企。下半年業績持續相對疲弱，導致年內     remained somewhat elevated, although better than in the first half of
股東應佔溢利下降33%至14億9千3百萬港元。   the year. The continued relatively weak performance in the second
                          half led to a reduction in profit attributable to shareholders of 33% to
                          HK$1,493 million for the year.

營運收入較2019年僅略為下跌3%。由於淨息差   income was slightly weaker than the prior year, with operating income
收縮，淨利息收入受壓。淨利息收入主要因較低     down 3% compared with 2019 despite a difficult year. Net interest
之淨息差而相對大幅下跌9%，然而非利息收入增    income was under pressure due to a weakening net interest margin. A
長18%，乃年內極其艱困環境下之不俗成績。     relatively substantial drop in net interest income of 9% caused mainly
                          by the lower net interest margin, was offset by an increase in non-
                          interest income of 18%, a fairly creditable outcome in what was a very
                          difficult year.

本集團之薪酬政策                The Group’s Remuneration Policy

本集團之薪酬政策旨在為僱員維持與市場條件相   The Group’s policy on remuneration is to maintain fair and competitive
若、公平且具競爭力之薪酬配套，並根據業務需   packages for its employees, which are commensurate with market
要、專業才能、個人之素質，且參照行業慣例與   terms, and are based on business needs, expertise and quality of
監管指引而訂立。                the individuals, and with proper reference to industry practice and
                        regulatory guidelines.


就釐定支付予董事會成員之袍金水平而言，將會   For determining the level of fees paid to members of the Board of
考慮市場的袍金水平及各董事之工作量及其須作   Directors, market rates and factors such as each director’s workload
出之承擔等因素。釐定執行董事薪酬待遇之考慮   and required commitment will be taken into account. The following
因素如下：                   factors are considered when determining the remuneration packages
                        of EDs:


－   業務需要及表現             –     Business needs and performance


－   整體經濟及商業情況           –     The economy and business conditions in general


－   個別對本集團之貢獻           –     Each individual’s contributions to the Group


－   風險相關之表現             –     Risk related performance


－   參考與個人職責相符之市場薪酬水平    –     Reference to market pay level commensurate with the
                              individual’s responsibility


－   遵行監管指引              –     Consideration of regulatory guidelines


－   留任之考慮因素及個別之潛能       –     Retention considerations and each individual’s potential


於考慮過程中，董事不可參與有關其本人薪酬之   During the process of consideration, no individual director will be
決定。                     involved in decisions relating to his/her own remuneration.

      2.3 利息收入及支出                                               2.3 Interest income and expense

      所有按攤餘成本及以公平值計量且其變動計入其                                     Interest income and expense are recognised in the income statement
      他全面收益計量之債務工具的利息收入及支出乃                                     for all debt instruments measured at amortised cost and fair value
      應用實際利率法確認於收益賬內。                                           through other comprehensive income using the effective interest
                                                                method.


      實際利率法乃是一種用以計算金融資產或金融負                                     The effective interest method is a method of calculating the amortised
      債之攤餘成本及其於相關期內攤分利息收入或利                                     cost of a financial asset or a financial liability and of allocating the
      息支出的方法。實際利率指可將金融工具在預計                                     interest income or interest expense over the relevant period. The
      有效期間或較短期間（如適用）內之估計未來現金                                    effective interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts estimated future
      收支貼現為該金融資產或金融負債之賬面淨值之                                     cash payments or receipts through the expected life of the financial
      適用貼現率。在計算實際利率時，本集團按金融                                     instrument or, when appropriate, a shorter period to the net carrying
      工具之所有合約條款（如提早清還之行使權）而估                                    amount of the financial asset or financial liability. When calculating the
      計其現金流量，但不考慮未發生之信貸損失。此                                     effective interest rate, the Group estimates cash flows considering all
      計算包括所有合約內交易雙方所收取或支付能構                                     contractual terms of the financial instrument (for example, prepayment
      成整體實際利息之費用及利率差價、交易成本及                                     options) but does not consider future credit losses. The calculation
      所有其他溢價或折讓。                                                includes all fees and points paid or received between parties to
                                                                the contract that are an integral part of the effective interest rate,
                                                                transaction costs and all other premiums or discounts.

             準則第15號原則下確認之收入。                                           accordance with the principles of HKFRS 15.

      本集團並無作出任何承擔以提供低於市場利率之                                     amount of the loss allowance. The Group has not provided any

      項目開始時被確定和記錄，亦於開始對沖時按預                                     hedge including hedged item, amount, interest rates, hedge period
      期基礎評估及不時根據實際經驗及估價重新評估                                     and purpose are determined and documented at the inception of each
      對沖有效性。倘公平值對沖關係不符合對沖會計                                     fair value hedge. Hedge effectiveness is assessed at inception on a
      的有效性測試標準，則對沖會計方法將於此公平                                     prospective basis and is reassessed, on an ongoing basis, based on
      值對沖失效日起停止。                                                actual experience and valuation. Fair value hedge relationships that
                                                                do not meet the effectiveness test requirement of hedge accounting

      3.2.3 減輕風險及控制額度之政策                                        3.2.3 Risk limit control and mitigation policies

      本集團已就個別借款人或交易對手集團、行業或                                     The Group has an established framework to manage and control
      國家設定框架管理及控制過度集中之風險。根據                                     concentrations risk with respect to individual borrower or counterparty
      借款人或交易對手集團、行業或國家之既定風險                                     group, industry or country. Exposure limits by borrower or counterparty
      額度，監察其風險狀況和向信貸委員會定期匯報。                                    group, industry or country are in place and their exposures are

      借款人或交易對手集團之最高風險額度是以資本                                     The large exposure limits to borrower or counterparty groups are

      之信貸評級而設定。所有設定的額度旨在達至更                                     the sovereign credit rating from international credit rating agencies. All
      為平衡的組合。                                                   these limits aim to achieve a more balanced portfolio.


      本集團於適當時，為減低信貸風險，會收取抵押                                     To mitigate credit risk and where appropriate, the Group will obtain
      品作為信貸額的擔保。為控制因衍生工具淨盤而                                     collateral to support the credit facility granted. To control credit
      產生之交易對手信貸風險，本集團限制其衍生工                                     risk exposure to counterparty arising from derivative positions,
      具買賣對手為核准之金融機構，應用已建立之市                                     the Group limits its derivative dealings with approved financial
      場慣例於信貸支援及抵押品之結算，減低衍生工                                     institutions, and uses established market practices on credit support
      具對手之信貸風險。本集團信貸委員會參考個別                                     and collateral settlement to reduce credit risk exposure to derivative

市場風險乃指由市場上利率及價格變化而引致對                     Market risk is the risk of losses in assets, liabilities and off-balance
資產、負債及資產負債表外持倉之虧損風險。                      sheet positions arising from movements in market rates and prices.


各類交易之市場風險均由董事會、風險管理及合                     Market risk exposure for different types of transactions is managed
規委員會及財資及投資風險委員會按董事會授予                     within various risk limits and guidelines approved by the Board, the
之權力所核准之各項風險限額及指引內處理。風                     RMCC and the TIRC under the authority delegated from the Board.
險限額按組合層面以及各產品及不同風險類別設                     Risk limits are set at the portfolio level as well as by products and
定。該等限額綜合包含了名義金額、止蝕限額、                     by different types of risks. The risk limits comprise a combination
敏感性及運用市場風險數值（「市場風險數值」）之                   of notional, stop-loss, sensitivity and value-at-risk (“VaR”) controls.
監控。所有涉及市場風險的買賣持倉需要每日按                     All trading positions are subject to daily mark-to-market valuation.
市值入賬。集團風險部之風險管理及監控部（「風                    The Risk Management and Control Department (“RMCD”) within the
險管理及監控部」）乃一個獨立之風險管理及控制                    GRD, as an independent risk management and control unit, identifies,
部門，負責比較風險和已審批限額，以識別、計                     measures, monitors and controls the risk exposures against approved
量、監控及管理該等風險及提議具體行動去確保                     limits and initiates specific actions to ensure positions are managed
持倉被限制在可接受水平內。任何不符合限額情                     within an acceptable level. Any exceptions have to be reviewed and
況均須依據有關政策及程序經合適管理層－財資                     sanctioned by the appropriate level of management of TIRC, RMCC or
及投資風險委員會，風險管理及合規委員會或董                     the Board as stipulated in the relevant policies and procedures.

3.3.1 源自買賣賬之市場風險（續）               3.3.1 Market risk arising from the trading book (Continued)

     （甲） 市場風險計量方法（續）                   (a)    Market risk measurement technique (Continued)

        (i)   市場風險數值                          (i)      Value at risk

        本集團應用市場風險數值法，其乃一                      The Group applies a VaR methodology, which is a
        種以統計為基準就持作買賣用途組合                      statistically based estimate, to measure the potential loss
        因市場不利變化預計潛在損失。其表                      of its trading portfolio from adverse market movements. It
        明本集團於某個置信水平可能損失之                      expresses as the maximum amount the Group might lose
        最大數額，就一日持倉期之基準作推                      given a certain level of confidence, which for the Group
        算，本集團之置信水平為99%。因此                     is 99% for a one day holding period. There is therefore a

        比市場風險數值之估計數為大。因此                      greater than the VaR estimate. Hence, the use of VaR does
        採納該方法並不能避免當市場狀況發                      not prevent losses outside the VaR limits in the event of
        生重大變化時超逾此等額度之損失。                      extreme market movements.

        史模擬方法計算。                              one calendar year using a method known as historical
                                              simulation approach.


        本集團藉著回顧測試買賣賬之市場風                      The VaR model is continuously validated by back-testing

     （丙）未按公平值計量之金融工具                 (c)    Financial instruments not measured at fair value

     下列方法和重要假定之應用，以釐定如下呈             The following methods and significant assumptions have been
     報的金融工具的公平價值：                    applied in determining the fair values of financial instruments
                                     presented below:


        (i)     在銀行的存款                      (i)      Placements with banks

        在銀行的浮息存款及隔夜存款之公平                    The fair value of floating rate placements and overnight
        值乃其賬面值。固定利息存款之估計                    deposits is their carrying amount. The estimated fair value
        公平值乃根據附有同類信貸風險及剩                    of fixed interest bearing deposits is based on discounted
        餘到期日之債務以當前貨幣市場利率                    cash flows using prevailing money-market interest rates for
        計算之貼現現金流。                           debts with similar credit risk and remaining maturity.


        (ii)    客戶貸款及墊款，及貿易票據               (ii)     Loans and advances to customers, and trade bills

        貸款及墊款及貿易票據之估計公平值                    The estimated fair value of loans and advances and trade
        指預計未來將會收回的現金流之貼現                    bills represents the discounted amount of estimated future
        數額。預計現金流按現行市場利率貼                    cash flows expected to be received. Expected cash flows
        現以釐定公平值。                            are discounted at current market rates to determine fair
                                            value.

於2020年12月31日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資之   At 31 December 2020, the fair value of the Group’s investment in
公平值已低於賬面值大約7年。為此，本集團持續      BOCQ had been below the carrying amount for approximately 7
對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測試以評       years. On this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment
估可收回金額。                     test on the carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the
                            recoverable amount.


減值測試比對以計算使用價值（「使用價值」）而釐     The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable
定之重慶銀行可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使       amount of BOCQ, determined by a value in use (“VIU”) calculation,
用價值乃按照管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來       with the carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses
將派股息，及經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長       discounted cash flow projections based on management’s estimates of
及資產淨值後之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用       BOCQ’s earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the estimated
貼現現金流量預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之       probable exit value in future after considering the growth of BOCQ and
貼現率乃參考可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本       its net asset value for the medium and longer term. The discount rate
成本而估算。                      applied to the VIU calculation was estimated with reference to BOCQ’s
                            cost of equity, which is publicly available in the market.

已計入就市場參與者而言之最高和最佳的物業用                            Measurement” and takes into account the highest and best use of the
途。                                               property from the perspective of market participants.


投資物業以大部份不可觀察之數據運用估值方法                            Investment properties are measured at fair value using valuation
計量公平值，其被分類至被界定為香港財務報告                            techniques with significant unobservable inputs which are classified
準則第13號《公平值計量》中公平值等級的第3級                          as Level 3 under the fair value hierarchy as defined in HKFRS 13, “Fair
別。                                               value measurement”.

層所確定的銷售單位價格，所確定之價格介乎每                            factors such as size and levels of buildings, which ranged from
平方呎1,928港元（2019年：1,850港元）至每平方                    HK$1,928 (2019: HK$1,850) to HK$114,000 (2019: HK$127,650) per
呎114,000港元（2019年：127,650港元）。銷售單                  square foot. A decrease in unit sale rate would result in decrease in
位價格的下降會導致投資物業之公平值計量有相                            fair value measurement of the investment properties by the same
應百分比的減少，反之亦然。                                    percentage and vice versa.

業之支出與其可復歸收入之潛力進行。公平值計                            on the basis of capitalisation of net incomes with due allowance

總體淨額結算安排                     Master netting arrangements

本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結算安        To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦        arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易        agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。        transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額        outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
結算及一般不會在財務狀況表中對銷資產及負債。       default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
                             on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets
                             and liabilities in the statement of financial position.

      外分行，而其總部是處於不同的國家，才會確認                                     is recognised if the claims against a counterparty are guaranteed by
      風險由一國家轉移至另一國家。經計及任何認可                                     another party in a different country or if the claims are on an overseas
